component.name: TraktLinkScreen
component.script:
sub init_x() m.top.findNode("header").color = accentColor() m.steps = m.top.findNode("steps") m.code = m.top.findNode("code") m.status = m.top.findNode("status") m.clientId = cfgRead("traktId", "") m.secret = cfgRead("traktSecret", "") if m.clientId = "" or m.secret = "" m.steps.text = "Primeiro cria uma app gratuita em trakt.tv/oauth/applications (Redirect URI: urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob) e cola o Client ID e o Client Secret em Definições → Configurar pelo telemóvel." return end if t = CreateObject("roSGNode", "TraktTask") t.request = { kind: "code", clientId: m.clientId } t.observeField("result", "onCode") t.control = "run" m.codeTask = t end sub sub init() try init_x() catch e reportCrash("TraktLinkScreen.init", e) end try end sub
sub onCode_x(event as object) res = event.getData() if not res.ok m.status.text = res.error return end if m.steps.text = "1. No telemóvel ou computador, abre:" + Chr(10) + res.url + Chr(10) + Chr(10) + "2. Inicia sessão no Trakt e escreve este código:" m.code.text = res.userCode m.status.text = "A aguardar confirmação…" m.pollTask = CreateObject("roSGNode", "TraktTask") m.pollTask.request = { kind: "poll", clientId: m.clientId, clientSecret: m.secret, deviceCode: res.deviceCode, interval: res.interval } m.pollTask.observeField("result", "onToken") m.pollTask.control = "run" end sub sub onCode(event as object) try onCode_x(event) catch e reportCrash("TraktLinkScreen.onCode", e) end try end sub
sub onToken_x(event as object) res = event.getData() if res.ok cfgWrite("traktToken", res.token) cfgWrite("traktRefresh", res.refresh) cfgWrite("traktExpires", strOr(res.expires)) m.status.text = "Trakt ligado!" m.top.linked = true else if strOr(res.error) <> "cancelado" m.status.text = strOr(res.error) end if end sub sub onToken(event as object) try onToken_x(event) catch e reportCrash("TraktLinkScreen.onToken", e) end try end sub
sub onClosing_x() if m.pollTask <> invalid then m.pollTask.cancel = true end sub sub onClosing() try onClosing_x() catch e reportCrash("TraktLinkScreen.onClosing", e) end try end sub
